item.title: Scaffold 2.1.0
item.description:
What's New in 2.1.0

  • Fixed Flame archive scripts referencing the wrong Flame version — Scaffold now detects your installed Flame version live (via Autodesk's own current-version marker) instead of assuming a hardcoded default, so archive scripts always target the correct project name, even after you update Flame.
  • Cleaned up the default project folder structure — removed unused exports, raw, and selects folders; Lightroom now lives alongside the other creative app folders in the main project folder instead of sitting at the top level.
